title: Starter: diode direction test with an LED
manual_page: Guided project: diode with LED indicator
finish: Parts placed. +5 V to the diode anode, banded end to the resistor, resistor to the LED long leg, LED short leg to ground. Then flip the diode and see the LED go out.

steps.instruction: Place the breadboard flat in front of the camera.
Place the 1N4007 diode on the left side. The band marks the cathode.

expect.label: diode
expect.zone_hint: Move the diode to the left half of the board.

steps.tip: Silver or white band equals cathode.

steps.instruction: Place the 330 ohm resistor (orange, orange, brown) after the diode's banded end.
Place the LED on the right side as the indicator.

expect.label: led
expect.zone_hint: Move the LED to the right half of the board.
